newsitem.title: INDIA: Kalyani, US groups to build highway in south India.
newsitem.headline: Kalyani, US groups to build highway in south India.

text.p: The government in the southern Indian state of Karnataka reached an understanding with the private Kalyani group and a U.S. firm to build an toll expressway, a top state official said on Wednesday.

"We have signed a MoU (memorandum of understanding) with the Kalyani group of Pune and VHB of Massachusetts," Usha Ganesh, secretary, infrastructure development department of the Karnataka government, told an infrastructure seminar.
She said the four-lane expressway, an elevated highway, would be 110 km (70 miles) long. It would be converted to a six-lane highway at a later stage, she said.
She did not give any financial details.
"We are in the final stages of discussion on terms of agreement," an official of Bharat Forge Ltd, a Kalyani group company in the western city of Pune, said.
He said the proposed toll highway plans to build industrial and residential townships along the way.
"It will relieve the urban pressure on Bangalore and Mysore," he said.
Karnataka's Usha Ganesh said the expressway was one of the several highways the state planned to build with private participation on a build, operate and transfer basis.
